findings.observed_contract: Complete current normative membership and bytes bind the independent base/target roots; missing, extra, changed or concurrently observed resources block recovery. This is transitive root binding, not a fresh semantic model load.
Rollback, completion and discard persist transaction receipts and action evidence. Explicit cleanup preserves archived work and permits subsequent real readers/writers only after terminal proof.
Operational writes before receipt or completion failures remain observable as mutation_possible; conflicting preexisting evidence remains untouched and does not become this call's write.
Bound auxiliary bytes are staged completely before publication, resumed after real process stops and rechecked against current sources; foreign or changed evidence is retained and blocks.
Self-description advertises retrievable model contracts and executable SRX library support separately from actually registered CLI commands and output formats.
The implemented Change Plan 1.2.0 schema is retrievable through the catalog with exact version identity and detached return values; no future operation or command is advertised.

Rationale and relation minima produce bound nonliteral Core findings, preserve independent literal findings and keep unavailable inputs incomplete. Full currentness integrations remain assigned to later product steps.

Actual configuration, language registry, selected profiles, SRX predicates and formal approval observations feed model/project/target validation. Missing authentic reviews, evidence and lifecycle history remain unavailable and cannot grant approval.

Active instructions use parallel-only Dev and Apply suites, including the final state; only the user starts workflow_dispatch CI. Historical serial executions remain historical. No documentation or wording tests are introduced.
Current scope/open items and real fixture providers are reconciled with collected behavior cases. No requirement is promoted to passed and no unavailable historical W/R/C evidence is invented.

Persisted independent basis evidence permits prepared/building discard reconstruction after fresh-process restart and interrupted completion; full inventory and byte checks preserve originals and reject unproved inputs.

Independent reference findings retain all known locations behind valid identity barriers. New closure cases compare whole-target and read-only project field findings; strict stored-relation planning rejects invalid source graphs before a ChangePlan exists.
